gate: A person carrying this code feels the drive to take something tangled and say it back simpler. Not summary, not paraphrase. The real thing, broken open, returned in a form somebody else can actually use. Knowing arrives in pieces here, and the gate is the work of fitting those pieces into language. The pressure shows up as restlessness when the words have not yet landed, an itch in the throat that says, the thing is understood but not yet out. The misread is that this is intellectual cleverness, the trick of explaining things well. It is not. The code is closer to translation than to teaching. Something already complete on the inside has to be split apart, named in fresh terms, and offered out. When the articulation finally clicks, there is a small private relief, like a knot loosening. Then the next tangle arrives.
centre_field: The throat is where everything in the body wants to arrive. It is the centre of manifestation, the place where a wordless impulse becomes a word, a gesture, a thing done in the world. Eleven gates connect into it, more than any other centre, which is the body's way of saying this is the hub. For this code, that placement is the whole teaching. The understanding alone does nothing. It has to cross into language, into voice, into a sentence somebody else can hear. The throat is the bottleneck and the doorway. Inside this centre, the code becomes communication, and only there. If the insight stays in the head, it sours. It loops. It turns into the feeling of being a freak nobody wants to listen to. The throat is what saves it. The energy is not finished until it has been said out.
channel: On its own, this code has nothing to say. It is the articulator without the source, the voice without the seeing. It needs the gate of insight to feed it, the sudden breakthrough that arrives whole from nowhere and demands a shape. The two together form the channel of structuring. The insight breaks through, the assimilation breaks it down. One produces the new knowing, the other gives it a form a person can carry. Alone, this code feels the pressure to speak with no clear thing to speak, which is its particular torment. Joined, it becomes the voice that turns private breakthroughs into shared structure. The reach is for what arrives from the deep, the unproven, the not yet said. The code is built to wait for that arrival, then to do the patient work of putting it into words. That is its half of the bargain.
